ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda Safe Mode boot coercion before ransomware encryption
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Qilin/Agenda chain of reconfiguring Windows boot to Safe Mode (with networking) via bcdedit, modifying RunOnce so the ransomware re-launches in Safe Mode where most EDR/AV agents do not load, and forcing a reboot. This Safe-Boot trick is a documented hallmark of the Qilin RaaS (formerly Agenda).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process) as bcdedit_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe Processes.process="*safeboot*" (Processes.process="*minimal*" OR Processes.process="*network*") NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM") by host Processes.process_id _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=outer host [| tstats summariesonly=true count as reboot_count values(Processes.process) as reboot_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=shutdown.exe OR Processes.process_name=cmd.exe) Processes.process="*shutdown*" Processes.process IN ("*/r*","*-r*","*/f*") by host _time span=1h] | join type=outer host [| tstats summariesonly=true count as runonce_count values(Registry.registry_path) as runonce_path values(Registry.registry_value_data) as runonce_value from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where (Registry.registry_path="*\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\SafeBoot\\*") by host _time span=1h] | eval signature="qilin_safeboot_coercion", risk_score=85 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | table firstTime host user parent bcdedit_cmd reboot_cmd runonce_path runonce_value signature risk_score
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let SafeBoot = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/set", "-set", "create")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("minimal", "network")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project SafeBootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SafeBootCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SafeBootParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SafeBootParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let RunOnceTamper = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where RegistryKey has_any (@"\CurrentVersion\RunOnce", @"\SafeBoot\Minimal", @"\SafeBoot\Network")
    | project RegTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RegKey = RegistryKey, RegValueName = RegistryValueName, RegValueData = RegistryValueData;
let ForcedReboot = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("shutdown.exe","cmd.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "shutdown"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/r ","/r/f","-r ","/r /f","/t 0")
    | project RebootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RebootCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
SafeBoot
| join kind=leftouter RunOnceTamper on DeviceId
| where isnull(RegTime) or RegTime between ((SafeBootTime - 30m) .. (SafeBootTime + 30m))
| join kind=leftouter ForcedReboot on DeviceId
| where isnull(RebootTime) or RebootTime between ((SafeBootTime - 5m) .. (SafeBootTime + 15m))
| extend ChainScore = iff(isnotempty(RegTime),1,0) + iff(isnotempty(RebootTime),1,0)
| project SafeBootTime, DeviceName, AccountName, SafeBootCmd, SafeBootParent, SafeBootParentCmd, RegKey, RegValueName, RegValueData, RebootCmd, ChainScore
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let SafeBoot = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("/set","-set","create")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("minimal","network")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
    | project SafeBootTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, SafeBootCmd = CommandLine, SafeBootParent = ParentProcessName;
let ForcedReboot = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith_cs @"\shutdown.exe" or NewProcessName endswith_cs @"\cmd.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "shutdown"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("/r ","-r ","/r/f","/t 0")
    | project RebootTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RebootCmd = CommandLine;
SafeBoot
| join kind=leftouter ForcedReboot on Computer
| where isnull(RebootTime) or RebootTime between ((SafeBootTime - 5m) .. (SafeBootTime + 15m))
| project SafeBootTime, Computer, Account, SafeBootCmd, SafeBootParent, RebootCmd
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Ransomware Safe Mode Boot Coercion via bcdedit
id: 6fa45c3b-2f1a-4b1c-9e3d-c81e7f0f2a01
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects use of bcdedit.exe to configure Windows to boot into Safe Mode (with networking).
  This is a signature behaviour of the Qilin (a.k.a. Agenda) ransomware operation, which
  reboots victims into Safe Mode so most EDR/AV drivers are not loaded before encryption.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/h/new-golang-ransomware-agenda-customizes-attacks.html
  - https://www.group-ib.com/blog/qilin-ransomware/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/05
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd_set:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot'
  selection_cmd_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '/set'
      - '-set'
      - 'create'
  selection_cmd_mode:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'minimal'
      - 'network'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_image and selection_cmd_set and selection_cmd_action and selection_cmd_mode and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Sysadmin troubleshooting requiring scheduled Safe-Mode boot (rare; correlate with change tickets)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*safeboot*minimal* OR *safeboot*network* OR *SAFEBOOT*MINIMAL* OR *SAFEBOOT*NETWORK*) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR LOCAL\ SERVICE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/safeboot/i
| CommandLine=/(minimal|network)/i
| CommandLine=/(\/set|-set|create)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(shutdown|cmd)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/shutdown/i CommandLine=/(\/r|-r)/i | rename(field="_time", as="reboot_time") | rename(field="CommandLine", as="reboot_cmd")}, field=aid, include=[reboot_time, reboot_cmd], mode=left)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine, reboot_cmd], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=first_seen)])
ucs.rationale: bcdedit setting `safeboot minimal|network` is virtually never a normal user/admin action and is a documented Qilin/Agenda hallmark — the affiliate playbook reboots into Safe Mode (with networking, so the encryptor can still talk to file shares) where Defender/EDR drivers do not load. Pairing the bcdedit invocation with a near-simultaneous shutdown /r /f /t 0 and (optionally) a RunOnce or SafeBoot\

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda Veeam-aware backup destruction + shadow copy wipe chain
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's signature pre-encryption sequence of enumerating and stopping Veeam backup services (Qilin affiliates specifically target Veeam to harvest stored credentials and prevent restore), followed within minutes by VSS shadow copy + backup catalog deletion. The Veeam-first ordering is more discriminating than generic vssadmin-delete hunts and is documented in Qilin/Agenda intrusion reporting.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as veeam_kill_time values(Processes.process) as veeam_kill_cmd values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN (net.exe, net1.exe, sc.exe, taskkill.exe, powershell.exe, pwsh.exe, wmic.exe) (Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*VeeamBackup*" OR Processes.process="*VeeamDeploymentService*" OR Processes.process="*VeeamNFSSvc*" OR Processes.process="*VeeamTransportSvc*" OR Processes.process="*VeeamMountSvc*") (Processes.process="*stop*" OR Processes.process="*kill*" OR Processes.process="*disable*" OR Processes.process="*delete*" OR Processes.process="*Stop-Service*") by host _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count as shadow_count min(_time) as shadow_delete_time values(Processes.process) as shadow_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN (vssadmin.exe, wmic.exe, wbadmin.exe, powershell.exe, pwsh.exe, diskshadow.exe) (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*Win32_ShadowCopy*" OR Processes.process="*Remove-WmiObject*ShadowCopy*" OR Processes.process="*resize shadowstorage*") by host _time span=10m] | where abs(shadow_delete_time - veeam_kill_time) <= 3600 | eval signature="qilin_veeam_then_vss_wipe", risk_score=90 | `security_content_ctime(veeam_kill_time)` | `security_content_ctime(shadow_delete_time)` | table veeam_kill_time shadow_delete_time host user parent veeam_kill_cmd shadow_cmd signature risk_score
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let VeeamKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Veeam Backup","VeeamBackup","VeeamDeploymentService","VeeamNFSSvc","VeeamTransportSvc","VeeamMountSvc","VeeamCatalog","VeeamBrokerSvc","VeeamCloudSvc")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop","Stop-Service","taskkill","/f /im","delete","disabled","config")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project VeeamKillTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              VeeamCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              VeeamParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              VeeamParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let ShadowDelete = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","diskshadow.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
        @"delete shadows",
        @"shadowcopy delete",
        @"delete catalog",
        @"Win32_ShadowCopy",
        @"Remove-WmiObject",
        @"resize shadowstorage",
        @"bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No",
        @"bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures")
    | project ShadowTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ShadowCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ShadowBinary = FileName;
VeeamKill
| join kind=inner ShadowDelete on DeviceId
| where ShadowTime between ((VeeamKillTime - 30m) .. (VeeamKillTime + 60m))
| extend MinutesBetween = datetime_diff('minute', ShadowTime, VeeamKillTime)
| project VeeamKillTime, ShadowTime, MinutesBetween, DeviceName, AccountName, VeeamCmd, VeeamParent, VeeamParentCmd, ShadowBinary, ShadowCmd
| order by VeeamKillTime desc
